description: Plugin invokes one bounded host operation; capability evaluated per invocation; the daemon result carries the superset vocabulary (success+ok+status+reason in three spellings) and a host-authored external_receipt
source: BBB_V2_AUDIT.md section 6.3; rpc.c:2057-2375 (entry 2300, result assembly 2165-2215, receipt 1501-1547); sev_bbb_client.h:29-37; bbb.go:309-365
checked_by: framing round-trip now; result-vocabulary decode is a host obligation (DELTA_D1 section 3)

vectors.name: request_minimal
vectors.note: both SDK clients require target and arguments to be JSON objects (bbb_client.c:1090-1100; bbb.go:314-315)

vectors.name: request_cancellable
vectors.note: work_done_token requires the rpc.cancel capability negotiated at connect (rpc.c:2063-2068)

vectors.name: response_success_superset
vectors.note: success+ok satisfy the C client decoder, status satisfies the Go client decoder, top-level body is the legacy duplicate (F-3, F-6); receipt fields per rpc.c:1516-1547 (further audit fields elided)

vectors.name: response_denied_as_result
vectors.note: same code string in all three spellings (rpc.c:2204-2206); one of the C client's five denial reason codes (sev_bbb_client.h:29-35)

vectors.name: response_cancelled_as_result
vectors.note: the cancelled path emits NO status field and only the snake reason_code (audit finding F-5: the Go SDK client misreads this as succeeded); receipt id is the work_done_token when set (rpc.c:1501-1514)

vectors.name: response_denied_as_error
vectors.payload_utf8: {"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":3,"error":{"code":-32000,"message":"Capability scope does not admit the requested operation","data":{"reasonCode":"OPERATION_SCOPE_MISMATCH","denied_at":"capability"}}}
vectors.note: capability-preparation denials arrive as errors, execution denials as results; clients must handle both (AUDIT section 8)

expect.message: grant is retired; invoke.call evaluates capability per request

vectors.name: invalid_token_without_negotiated_cancel
vectors.note: invalid only for a session that did not negotiate rpc.cancel (audit finding F-4: every Go-SDK-client plugin today)
